las-medulas-roman-gold-mine.description: A torrent of water bursts from a stone-arched tunnel mouth in a red rock face and tears down a collapsing hillside. Below, bearded men in brown tunics and bare legs work with long-handled rakes and shovels in shallow muddy channels, while timber sluice boxes carry the brown slurry. Stormy grey sky, dust and spray. No visible text or frame; a tiny coloured mark sits in the bottom-right corner.

kutna-hora-silver-strike.description: A man in a hooded pale tunic and worn trousers grips a rope in one hand and holds a lantern in the other. Beside him is a wicker basket of silver-grey ore. He stands in a dark, narrow shaft with timber supports and rough rock walls, and a hand windlass with a rope drum sits at the top. The scene is lit only by the lantern and a few embers.

joachimsthal-silver-rush.description: A bearded man in a leather apron and rough shirt swings a hammer above a heavy wooden stump. On the stump a metal coin-striking die sits with a few silver coins, and more coins are stacked at the left and scattered on the wood. Behind him, through a open wooden doorway, a forested mountain slope shows a wooden mine headframe, smoke and small figures working among spoil heaps. A fire glows at the left edge.

zacatecas-silver-strike.description: A bearded man in a metal morion helmet and brown leather jerkin kneels on rocky ground, examining a lump of grey ore with white metallic veins. Behind him a dark mule with packs and two figures in simple cloth, one holding a tool, stand on dry, dusty highland. A jagged, crested hill rises in the background under a hazy sky. Painterly oil style, edge to edge, no text.

minas-gerais-gold-rush.description: A man in a brimmed hat and quilted vest stands knee-deep in a forest stream, tilting a wooden pan in which yellow gold flecks catch the light. Dense tropical vines and trees surround him, painted in a dark oil style. No visible text, frame or border.

brazil-diamonds-discovered.description: A weathered, bearded man in a dirt-stained linen shirt crouches on mossy rocks beside a fast forest stream. He holds a small pale stone up between his fingers and looks at it intently. A wooden pan of glittering gravel sits in the water at his feet. Behind him are dense tropical trees and steep rock cliffs, in a dark painterly style. I see no text, frame or gore.

berezovsk-first-russian-gold.description: A bearded man in tattered grey-brown peasant clothing kneels on a forest floor of pine and birch trees, holding a white quartz rock with gold streaks. Roots, moss and fallen twigs surround him, and a small pit is dug beside him. The style is a dark, painterly oil look with soft light falling through the trees. No text, frame or graphic content is visible.

reed-gold-nugget-north-carolina.description: A barefoot boy in a loose linen shirt and trousers stands in an open plank doorway of a log cabin, carrying a long pole over one shoulder and looking out at sunlit forest. A large raw gold nugget lies on the wooden floor beside the door. The cabin has log walls, a wooden barrel at right and a small bench at left. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no text.

georgia-gold-rush.description: A painting of several men panning for gold in a misty, wooded stream. In the foreground a man in a slouch hat and long coat kneels, holding a metal pan that shows bright gold flakes. Beside him a second man in a hat and waistcoat tends a wooden sluice box in the running water. Behind them many more men with shovels work among tall trees. Shovels and 19th-century dress are the era cues. No visible text, frame or gore; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

eureka-diamond-found.description: A barefoot young person in a worn wide-brimmed hat and dusty loose shirt crouches on a stony riverbank, looking closely at a small glowing stone in cupped fingers. A handful of ordinary pebbles sits in the other palm, and a single bright crystal lies in the sand below. Behind is a dark, still river and dry scrub under a shadowy hillside. Painterly, warm, low light, no text or border.
